rules.requirement: Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until dusk. You become their alignment.

assertingTests.name: the Goon drinks its first chooser until dusk and takes their alignment (BMR-GOON-01)
a Pukka poisoned by its own poison can choose a sober Goon: it is drunk until dusk and the Goon turns evil (BMR-GOON-01, BMR-PUKKA-07)
a permanent effect on its own source resolves beside that source's own poison (SYS-EFFECTS-04, BMR-GOON-01)
a permanent effect holds while its source is already poisoned, in either visiting order (SYS-EFFECTS-04, BMR-GOON-01)
